paras: Upgrade your Toyota GR Supra or BMW's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

Important: This pad suits the GR Supra GT , the four cylinder model fitted with 330mm rear rotors . It does not fit the GTS or other six cylinder Supra models, which use a larger rear brake package. Please confirm your model grade and measure your rear disc before ordering.
